name: Cheshire Cat AI
short_desc: Production-ready AI agent for your sites with memory, plugins, REST/WS APIs.
author: cheshire-cat-ai
description: Cheshire Cat powers site-specific AI agents. This package exposes the Admin (/admin) and REST/WS APIs. Vector memory via Qdrant is pre-wired.

form_fields.label: Public host for admin/API
form_fields.hint: e.g. ai.example.com (used by the Admin portal)

form_fields.label: Public port
form_fields.hint: External port Runtipi exposes (maps to container 80).

form_fields.label: HTTPS proxy mode
form_fields.hint: Enable when fronted by Traefik/Nginx with TLS to fix redirect/headers.

form_fields.label: Use secure protocols
form_fields.hint: Set true if Cat is served via HTTPS/WSS.

form_fields.label: JWT secret
form_fields.hint: Used to sign JWTs for browser clients.

form_fields.label: Disable dev auto-reload
form_fields.hint: Set false (production) to avoid restarts on file changes.

form_fields.label: Qdrant host
form_fields.hint: Defaults to the bundled qdrant service name.
